newsitem.title: CHINA: China First Tractor Group 97 sales seen at $662 ml.
newsitem.headline: China First Tractor Group 97 sales seen at $662 ml.

text.p: China's Yituo Group Co Ltd, which includes Hong Kong-listed arm First Tractor Co Ltd expects its sales revenue to reach 5.5 billion yuan ($662 million) in 1997, a company official said on Tuesday.

The group, which is the largest agricultural tractor maker in China, notched up sales revenues of more than 500 million yuan in April alone, with 40 million yuan in post-tax profit, the official said by telephone.
Sales revenue last year was 4.3 billion yuan, with post-tax profit at 147 million yuan, he said but gave no further details.
The group's Hong Kong-listed First Tractor Co floated 300 million H-shares on Monday in an issue that was nearly 300 times oversubscribed. ($1 = 8.3 yuan)
